common.name: session-handoff
common.requirements: Node.js ≥ 22.20 (Skills CLI) · Python ≥ 3.9 (manual install / site build)

en.title: Keep the context. Continue the work.
en.description: Session and project handoffs for coding agents, delivered as standalone HTML with Markdown audit sources. Keep decisions, evidence, diagrams, and next steps readable offline.
en.headline:
Continue a task.
Hand over a project.
en.intro: Carry a task into a fresh conversation, or give a new maintainer the context to run and maintain an entire project. Both scopes support local continuation and GitHub sharing, in the language of your request.
en.tagline: Session and project handoffs. Standalone HTML by default. MIT licensed.
en.example_note: Illustrative example; repository and version are specified in a real handoff.
en.sample_local:
Goal
Finish the CSV export feature.

Verified state
Export works; timezone regression still needs a test.

Read first
Project rules, export module, current diff.

Next action
Add the timezone regression test, then run the export tests.

Boundary
Implementation only. Deployment needs approval.
en.sample_share:
Goal
Continue the export feature from a fixed GitHub commit.

Get the work
Repository URL + full commit SHA + relative file paths.

Prepare
Runtime, locked dependencies, inputs, and access requirements.

Run & verify
Exact commands, expected result, and next action.

Open dependency
Recipient must configure their own API credentials.
en.bridge: The useful part of a conversation should survive the conversation.
en.bridge_text: A summary tells you what happened. A handoff also tells the next person where to begin, what was verified, and what is still missing.
feature_texts: Carry forward the chosen direction, corrections, and authorization scope.
Separate completed work from plans, old test results, and assumptions.
Name the files, commands, inputs, and success condition needed to continue.
en.modes_heading: Two ways to pass the work on.
en.local_text: Move to a fresh conversation with the current workspace, relevant files, and the first action ready to go.
en.share_title: Give someone else a starting point
en.share_text: Use accessible GitHub files and a fixed commit. Document setup, permissions, commands, and any dependency that still blocks execution.
en.install_text: Run the command, choose your agent, and ask for a handoff. The CLI installs to the current project by default; add -g for a global installation.
en.install_note: Requires Node.js 22.20+. Prefer no Node dependency? Clone the repository and use the Python installer.
en.copy_failed: Select and copy the text manually.
en.prompt_heading: Ask for a task handoff or a project handover.
en.prompt_local: Use $session-handoff to prepare a self-contained continuation prompt for a fresh conversation. Preserve decisions, verified state, authorization scope, and the next action.
en.prompt_share: Use $session-handoff to prepare a handoff for a teammate who cannot access my machine or chat history. Use accessible GitHub files at a fixed commit; include setup, run, and verification commands. Identify any missing dependency.
en.example_cta: Read a complete, runnable handoff example
faq_q: Can I read the handoff offline?
Does the recipient need this skill?
What if the project needs private data?
faq_a: Yes. The default HTML includes essential prose, inline styles, and embedded visuals without requiring JavaScript or a network connection. Fetching project code or private inputs can still require the access described in the document.

Yes. Handoff prose follows your current request’s language, or your explicit output-language instruction. Commands, paths, identifiers, and source logs are preserved. This also applies when editing handoff text.
No. A shared handoff should contain the instructions and accessible source references needed to continue.
The handoff workflow requires explicit authorization before publishing, pushing, or changing access. Installing it does not grant that authorization.
The handoff should identify the access requirement or missing dependency. It should never embed credentials or claim a project is runnable while required inputs are unavailable.

The package includes Codex metadata and standard SKILL.md instructions. The Skills CLI can install it to supported agents; behavior varies by host. The core instructions are in Chinese and request output in the user’s language.
en.footer: Built for continuity. Shared under MIT.
en.manual_text: From a clone of this repository, run the standard-library installer. It respects CODEX_HOME and refuses to overwrite an existing installation.
en.verify_text: The website and these READMEs are generated from site/content.json. No frontend dependency or external font is required. Pull requests run Python 3.9 compatibility tests, Python 3.12 checks, and generated-file consistency checks; only main can deploy Pages.
en.contribute_text: See CONTRIBUTING.md for behavioral scenarios and contribution requirements. The skill and installer are MIT licensed. This is a workflow for an agent to follow; it does not run arbitrary projects by itself.
en.scope_heading: Choose the scope. Then the recipient.
en.scope_intro: A new teammate may need one task or the whole project. The handoff scope and the way you share it are independent.
en.scope_session_local: Current task, decisions, relevant changes, next action.
en.scope_session_share: Current task at an accessible revision, with inputs and execution steps.
en.scope_project_local: Project goals, structure, dependencies, current capabilities, operations, and backlog.
en.scope_project_share: A whole-project guide with accessible sources, fixed versions, setup, verification, and maintenance.
en.sample_project:
Project
A CSV export service, including API and background worker.

Map & dependencies
Entry points, module roles, runtime, data, and services.

Current capabilities
Working paths, verified versions, gaps, and unfinished work.

Operate & maintain
Build, tests, CI, logs, deployment and recovery references.

Take over
Access requirements, priority backlog, first maintenance action.
en.prompt_project: Use $session-handoff to hand over this entire project to a new maintainer via GitHub. Cover goals, architecture, dependencies, current capabilities and evidence, operations, backlog, and the first maintenance action. Use accessible sources at fixed revisions; identify missing inputs or permissions.
en.language_note: Handoff text follows the language of your current request, unless you explicitly request another language. Commands, identifiers, paths, and original logs stay accurate.
en.identity_note: The repository is named handoff-skill. The installed skill ID remains session-handoff, so existing $session-handoff requests continue to work.
en.scope_example_note: Session is the default for “handoff this conversation.” Ask for a “project handoff” or “hand over the whole project” to include overall structure and maintenance.
en.delivery_heading: A handoff you can read on its own.
en.delivery_text: Both Session and Project handoffs default to a standalone HTML file, with the same Markdown audit source. The essential context, evidence, commands, and explanations stay in the document—even offline and without JavaScript.
en.delivery_visuals: Include embedded diagrams or screenshots when they help someone understand the structure, workflow, or current state. Each visual needs a caption and a text alternative. Source code and large inputs remain available through the documented GitHub access requirements.
en.delivery_override: An explicit request for plain text, Markdown only, another format, or no saved files takes priority.
en.prompt_resume: Use $session-handoff to resume from handoff.md. Check the current project rules, revision, working tree, and relevant evidence, then continue the first authorized action. Report any difference from the handoff.
en.manual_details: Python ≥ 3.9. `python3 scripts/install.py --dest /path/to/skills/session-handoff` installs to a chosen skill directory. Existing directories, files, and symlinks are never overwritten. Back up your old installation before updating. Remove only the installed skill directory to uninstall.
en.compatibility_note: The package follows the SKILL.md format and includes Codex metadata. Other agents’ installation support depends on the host and the [Skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills). Core instructions are in Chinese; output follows the user's language. Recipients do not need this skill installed, but still need the project's environment, permissions, inputs, and credentials.
en.example_build_note: To regenerate the standalone HTML example, use Python 3.10+ with `python3 -m pip install -r requirements-examples.txt`, then run `python3 scripts/render_example.py` before the site build. Skill use, installation, site building, and the standard-library tests do not require this optional rendering dependency.
en.preview_note: For local preview, run `python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory docs` and open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`. Edit product copy in `site/content.json`, presentation in `site/index.html` or `site/assets/`, then rebuild. `examples/shared-handoff.md` demonstrates a fixed-version checkout and build.

zh.title: 保留上下文，让工作继续。
zh.description: 支持 Session 与 Project 的交接 Skill，默认交付离线 HTML 与同源 Markdown，让背景、证据、必要图示和接手步骤独立可读。
zh.headline:
继续当前任务，
交接整个项目。
zh.intro: 把当前任务交给新会话，或让新维护者理解、运行并继续维护整个项目。两种范围都支持同机续接与 GitHub 分享，交接内容自动使用你的请求语言。
zh.tagline: 支持 Session 与 Project，默认交付独立 HTML，采用 MIT 许可。
zh.example_note: 以下为结构示例；实际交接需要填写真实仓库和版本。
zh.sample_local:
目标
完成 CSV 导出功能。

已验证状态
导出可用；时区问题仍需要回归测试。

先读取
项目规则、导出模块和当前 diff。

下一步
增加时区回归测试，再运行导出相关测试。

授权范围
完成实现；部署需要另行授权。
zh.sample_share:
目标
从 GitHub 上的固定版本继续导出功能。

获取资料
仓库 URL、完整 commit SHA、仓库相对路径。

准备环境
运行时、锁定依赖、输入数据与访问条件。

运行和验证
具体命令、预期结果，以及第一项可执行工作。

待满足条件
接收者需要配置自己的 API 凭据。
zh.bridge: 对话结束后，有用的上下文应该留下。
zh.bridge_text: 摘要说明发生过什么。交接还需要让接手的人知道从哪里开始、哪些结果有证据、还缺什么。
feature_texts: 继承已经确定的方向、用户纠正和准确的授权范围。
区分已完成工作、计划、历史测试和仍待核验的假设。
写清需要的文件、命令、输入和可观察的完成条件。
zh.modes_heading: 两种交接方式，按接手对象选择。
zh.local_text: 把当前工作区、关键文件和第一项行动带进新会话，让新 Agent 能够找到现场。
zh.share_text: 使用对方可访问的 GitHub 文件与固定 commit，写清环境、权限、运行命令，以及尚未解决的依赖。
zh.install_text: 运行命令，选择使用的 Agent，然后提出交接请求。CLI 默认安装到当前项目；加上 -g 可全局安装。
zh.install_note: 需要 Node.js 22.20 或更新版本。不想依赖 Node？克隆仓库后使用 Python 安装器。
zh.copy_failed: 请选中文本后手动复制。
zh.prompt_heading: 按任务续接或整个项目移交提出请求。
zh.prompt_local: 请使用 $session-handoff，把当前任务整理成可粘贴到新对话继续执行的交接提示词，保留决定、验证证据、授权范围和下一步。
zh.prompt_share: 请使用 $session-handoff，整理一份可以分享给协作者的交接文档。对方看不到我的本地文件和聊天记录。请使用 GitHub 固定版本，写清环境准备、运行与验证命令，明确尚未交付的必要依赖。
zh.example_cta: 阅读一份完整、可执行的分享交接示例
faq_q: 交接文档能离线阅读吗？
输出会跟随我的语言吗？
接收者也要安装这个 Skill 吗？
它会自动发布我的工作吗？
项目需要私有数据怎么办？
faq_a: 能。默认 HTML 内含核心正文、样式和必要图示，不依赖网络或脚本。获取项目代码、私有数据等运行资料，仍需满足文档中写明的访问条件。
会。交接正文与修改后的说明默认使用当前请求的语言；明确指定输出语言时优先遵从。命令、路径、标识符和原始日志保持准确。
不需要。分享文档本身应包含接手说明，以及接收者可访问的资料入口。
交接流程要求发布、推送或修改权限前获得明确授权；安装 Skill 不会授予这些权限。
交接应说明访问条件或缺少的依赖，不应嵌入密钥，也不能在必要输入尚未交付时声称对方已可运行。
包中包含 Codex 元数据和标准 SKILL.md 指令。Skills CLI 可将其安装到支持的 Agent；执行行为取决于宿主。核心指令使用中文，要求按用户的语言输出。
zh.footer: 让工作继续。以 MIT 许可分享。
zh.manual_text: 克隆本仓库后，运行仅依赖 Python 标准库的安装器。它遵循 CODEX_HOME，并拒绝覆盖已有安装。
zh.verify_text: 主页和两份 README 由 site/content.json 生成，无需前端依赖或外部字体。Pull Request 会运行 Python 3.9 兼容性测试、Python 3.12 检查和生成文件一致性检查；仅 main 分支可部署 Pages。
zh.contribute_text: 行为检查场景与贡献要求见 CONTRIBUTING.md。Skill 和安装器采用 MIT 许可。它提供供 Agent 遵循的工作流，不会自行运行任意项目。
zh.scope_heading: 先确定交接范围，再确定接收对象。
zh.scope_intro: 交给别人接手的，可能是一项任务，也可能是整个项目。交接范围与分享方式是两个独立维度。
zh.scope_session_local: 当前任务、关键决定、相关改动与下一步。
zh.scope_session_share: 对方可获取的任务版本、输入与执行步骤。
zh.scope_project_local: 项目目标、结构、依赖、整体能力、维护方式与待办。
zh.scope_project_share: 完整项目接手说明、固定版本、环境、验证与维护步骤。
zh.sample_project:
项目
CSV 导出服务，包含 API 和后台 worker。

结构与依赖
入口、模块职责、运行时、数据与外部服务。

整体能力
可用路径、验证版本、缺口与未完工作。

运行与维护
构建、测试、CI、日志、部署与恢复文档。

接手顺序
访问条件、优先待办与第一项维护动作。
zh.prompt_project: 请使用 $session-handoff，把整个项目交接给新维护者，通过 GitHub 分享。请覆盖目标、结构、依赖、整体能力与验证证据、运行维护、待办和第一项维护动作。使用对方可访问的固定版本，明确缺少的输入或权限。
zh.project_example_cta: 打开独立 HTML 项目交接示例
zh.language_note: 交接正文默认跟随用户当前请求的语言；明确指定输出语言时，以指定为准。命令、标识符、路径和原始日志保持准确。
zh.identity_note: 仓库名称为 handoff-skill，已安装 Skill 的标识仍是 session-handoff，已有 $session-handoff 调用继续有效。
zh.scope_example_note: “交接一下／换个对话继续”默认按 Session 处理；“项目交接／交接整个项目”会覆盖整体结构与维护方式。
zh.delivery_heading: 一份文件，就能独立阅读。
zh.delivery_text: Session 与 Project 默认都交付独立 HTML，并保留同源 Markdown。必要的背景、证据、命令和操作说明留在文档中，断网、禁用脚本也能阅读。
zh.delivery_visuals: 当结构、流程或当前状态需要图文解释时，嵌入相应图示或截图，配上图注与文字说明。代码和大文件仍按文档中的 GitHub 入口及权限要求获取。
zh.delivery_override: 用户明确要求纯文本、仅 Markdown、其他格式或不落盘时，按指定方式交付。
zh.prompt_resume: 请使用 $session-handoff，根据 handoff.md 继续工作。先核验当前项目规则、版本、工作区与相关证据，说明与交接记录的差异，再执行第一项已授权工作。
zh.manual_details: 需要 Python ≥ 3.9。使用 `python3 scripts/install.py --dest /path/to/skills/session-handoff` 指定安装目录。已有目录、文件和符号链接均不会被覆盖；更新前请先备份旧安装。卸载时仅移除所安装的 Skill 目录。
zh.compatibility_note: 安装包遵循 SKILL.md 格式，并包含 Codex 元数据。其他 Agent 的安装支持取决于宿主与 [Skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)。核心指令使用中文，输出跟随用户请求的语言。接收者不需要安装此 Skill，但仍需具备项目运行环境、权限、输入和自己的凭据。
zh.example_build_note: 重新生成独立 HTML 示例需要 Python 3.10+。先运行 `python3 -m pip install -r requirements-examples.txt`，再运行 `python3 scripts/render_example.py`，最后构建网站。Skill 使用、安装、网站构建和标准库测试不依赖这个可选渲染组件。
zh.preview_note: 本地预览运行 `python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory docs`，打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`。产品文案修改 `site/content.json`，展示模板与资源修改 `site/index.html` 或 `site/assets/`，然后重新构建。`examples/shared-handoff.md` 提供固定版本检出与构建示例。
